name: Large centred testimonial quote
purpose: Breaks up product storytelling with a single big customer endorsement, optionally handing off to a demo CTA.
description: One component with a `variant` prop: a 32px (28 tab / 24 mob) medium-weight quote in a 60rem column, above a stacked author block (avatar, name, grey role + linked or bold org). Variants only change spacing, alignment and avatar size: platform (/lms 1st, /lms/features, /lms/solutions with a centred button row below), platform-lg (/lms 2nd, 5rem top + 4rem bottom margin), section (/lms 3rd, 5rem/3rem section padding, button rendered inside the author block), mid-market (/lms/corporate-lms, bare left-aligned quote, 2rem top margin), enterprise (/lms/enterprise, centred quote with 2rem left pad, 1rem top margin), kiki (/nova, 6rem/5rem/3.5rem top pad, 3rem avatar). Avatar is a 5rem (3rem kiki) square with the site's 6px TL/BR tag corners below 1440 and fully round at >=1440.

variant.note: Spacing/alignment variant; same content shape for all.

preset.note: Default-copy key in PRESETS (defaults to the variant); explicit fields override it. autotabs presets belong to the autotabs group block.

quote.note: Full quote including its opening/closing quotation marks.

role.note: Job title; when org is set it usually ends with a comma or 'at'.
role.measuredLongestRealInstance: 10 words in the clone's own placeholder copy

org.note: Organisation, rendered as an inline link (or bold for the platform-lg preset) after the role.
org.measuredLongestRealInstance: 3 words in the clone's own placeholder copy

placeholderLabel.note: Label drawn inside the neutral placeholder slot (Placeholder.jsx label prop).

assetRef.note: ONLY for roles whose generationPolicy is may-generate-new (ASSET_REF_FORBIDDEN_FOR_PROTECTED_ROLE). Must point at a NEWLY generated file under generated/ -- never /assets/, public/assets/ or a URL. The 56 files in the source project's public/assets/ are the user's local reference copies of the original site's imagery and are never valid here.

ctaLabel.note: Primary button label. Rendered only for platform / platform-lg (centred row below the quote) and section (inside the author block).
ctaLabel.measuredLongestRealInstance: 4 words in the clone's own placeholder copy

evidenceNotes: The component also has 'autotabs' and 'autotabs-enterprise' variants, but those are rendered only inside AutotabsGroup.jsx (closing quote of that block), not placed directly by pages; they are left out of this contract's variant enum.
/lms places three instances (platform, platform-lg, section); each variant appears at most once per page, so maxPerPage 3 counts the section as a whole.
The platform-lg preset renders org in <strong>; all others render it as an inline link (orgStyle is a styling knob, not modelled).

/lms/features passes preset 'platform-features' with its own 40-word quote; that preset sets orgBreak (two
after the org).
